The change has no problems I could confirm. `create_booking` doesn't validate a zero or negative party size either, so `ChangePartySize` is consistent with it. The SQLite `bookings` table has no unique constraint on the slot, so `insert or replace` in `save` can only overwrite a row with the same `id`. The in-memory `save` replaces by `id` in the same way, so the two repositories behave alike.
